c74object.name: mab~
c74object.digest: RAVE / AFTER TorchScript inference in Max.
c74object.description: mab~ loads a TorchScript model (e.g. RAVE or AFTER) in a separate Python worker process and performs inference via shared memory. The object exposes audio or latent signal inlets/outlets depending on the active method (forward, encode, decode, prior). The Python process stays alive when bypassed or disabled; use reload to restart it.

objarg.name: model
objarg.digest: Path to a TorchScript model file.
objarg.description: Absolute or package-relative path to a TorchScript (.ts) model. If no path is given the object starts in "no model" state and waits for a load message.

objarg.name: method
objarg.description: Name of the model method to run. Common values are forward, encode, decode and prior. Defaults to forward.

objarg.name: buffer_size
objarg.description: Number of samples processed in one inference block. Defaults to 512.

objarg.name: gpu
objarg.description: Non-zero loads the model onto the GPU. Defaults to 0 (CPU).

objarg.name: num_channels
objarg.description: Channel count hint passed to the worker. Defaults to 1.

objarg.name: cores
objarg.description: Number of CPU threads used by PyTorch, OMP, MKL and OpenBLAS. Defaults to 1. Ignored in GPU mode.

method.name: enable
method.description: enable 1 turns processing on; enable 0 bypasses audio without killing the Python worker.

method.name: gpu
method.description: gpu 1 moves inference to the GPU; gpu 0 uses the CPU. The worker reloads the model when changed.

method.name: reload
method.description: Shuts down the current worker and starts a fresh one with the current model and settings. Use this to recover from a worker crash.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Print model state to the Max console.
method.description: Posts the current model path, method, buffer size, GPU mode, layout and ready state. Also requests a full metadata dump from the worker.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set an attribute or forward it to the model.
method.description: Built-in attributes: set gpu 0/1, set buffer_size samples, set channels n. Any other name is forwarded to the model as an attribute.

method.name: get
method.description: Built-in queries: gpu, buffer_size, channels, ready, method, model. Other names are forwarded to the model.

method.name: method
method.description: Switch to a different model method (forward, encode, decode, prior). The inlets and outlets are rebuilt automatically on the Max main thread.

method.name: load
method.description: load path sets a new model path and triggers a reload.

attribute.name: gpu
attribute.description: Non-zero when the worker is running on the GPU.

attribute.name: buffer_size
attribute.description: Number of samples collected before one inference call.

attribute.name: channels
attribute.description: Channel count hint used by the worker.
